physDesc.physMedium: 1 halved bifolio (24.5 x 27 cm). Paper: originally 18 staves of which 6 have been cut off. Paginated 89-92. Music written upside-down. Contains sketches for the first movement. 1 bifolio (37.5 x 27 cm). Paper: 18 staves. Paginated 93-96. Contains sketches for first, second and fourth movements, but also for the final chorus of the cantata "Zion" (NWGW 177). On fol.2r dated "Sepbr / 74" and on fol.2v "22 September 74.". 1 single folio (24.5 x 27 cm). Paper 20 staves. Contains an almost complete draft for the Finale. 1 bifolio (26.5 x 17.5). Paper: 12 staves. Contains sketches for the third movement, dated "4 Oct 74.". 1 bifolio (26.5 x 17.5). Paper: 12 staves. Contains a draft for the third movement also dated "4 Oct / 74.". All sketches and drafts written in ink.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Paginated 1-31. Last page blank. Heading above the music on p. 2: "Concertstykke / for / Stryge-Orchester". At the end of the first and second movements dated "Septbr. 74."; at the end of the third movement dated: "5 October / 74."; at the end of the fourth movement dated "20 October 1874 / Christiansborg" and Gade's musical signature.
